function.name: mail.SendFile
function.content: result, error = mail.SendFile(receiver, subject, content, disk_id, file_path, password)
subject: string; mail subject. specify nil if no subject needed
content: string; mail content. specify nil if no content needed
disk_id: integer; 0: HMI, 2: USB, 3: SD, 6: USB2
file_path: string; file path related to disk_id
password: string; password for the file. specify nil if no password required
-- compress 'test/file.txt' with password '1234' in USB disk and send it to test@test.com
result, error = mail.SendFile("test@test.com", "test mail subject", "test mail content", 2, "test/file.txt", "1234")
-- compress 'test/file.txt' with NO password in SD card and send it to 'test@test.com'
result, error = mail.SendFile("test@test.com", "test mail subject", "test mail content", 3, "test/file.txt", nil)
To get result of mail procedure, use mail.Status()

function.name: mail.SendAlarm
function.content: result, error = mail.SendAlarm(receiver, subject, content, password)
subject: string; mail subject. specify nil if no subject needed
content: string; mail content. specify nil if no content needed
password: string; password for the file. specify nil if no password required
-- compress alarm CSV with password '1234' and send it to test@test.com
result, error = mail.SendAlarm("test@test.com", "test mail subject", "test mail content", "1234")
-- compress alarm CSV with NO password and send it to 'test@test.com'
result, error = mail.SendAlarm("test@test.com", "test mail subject", "test mail content", nil)
To get result of mail procedure, use mail.Status()

function.name: mail.SendHistory
function.content: result, error = mail.SendHistory(bufferNo, dayRange, receiver, subject, content, password)
dayRange: integer; day range of history buffer CSV. This parameter only valids from 1~7 and "Save As Multi" must be enabled.
subject: string; mail subject. specify nil if no subject needed
content: string; mail content. specify nil if no content needed
password: string; password for the file. specify nil if no password required
-- compress history 1 CSV with password '1234' and send it to test@test.com
result, error = mail.SendHistory(1, 0, "test@test.com", "test mail subject", "test mail content", "1234")
-- compress history 2 CSV within 5 days with NO password and send it to 'test@test.com'
result, error = mail.SendHistory(2, 5, "test@test.com", "test mail subject", "test mail content", nil)
To get result of mail procedure, use mail.Status()
